Three Quiet Bombshells Just Reshaped Immigration Law. Nobody Noticed. (by Pablo Manríquez). A federal court wiped out four USCIS policies. A new rule could strip work permits from hundreds of thousands. And asylum seekers are now paying a tax — every year — just to wait.

The Darkest Chapter of Immigration Enforcement Starts Now (by Pablo Manríquez). Congressional Republicans just spent another $70 billion on mass deportations. The only silver lining here is that ICE will never get its legitimacy back.

Federal Judge Kills Trump's $100,000 H-1B Fee (by Pablo Manríquez). A Boston court rules the six-figure charge was an illegal tax. Thousands of foreign workers and the employers who need them are watching what happens next.

Republicans Are Building a Quarter-Trillion Dollar Anti-Immigrant Machine With No Off Switch (by Pablo Manríquez). Three moving parts. One direction. A quarter-trillion dollars aimed at immigration enforcement — and a generation of migrants in the crosshairs.
The Abbott Donor Behind the “Abolish ICE” Campaign (by Pablo Manríquez). Avila Chevalier wants to abolish ICE, but her biggest outside backer helped elect hyper-xenophobic Texas Governor Greg Abbott.

Beth Davidson Profits From ICE After Killing the Bill to Limit ICE. Now She's Running Ads About Standing Up to ICE. (by Pablo Manríquez). NY-17 frontrunner Beth Davidson holds $395,000 in Microsoft, Amazon, and Oracle stock — and $5 million in equities overall — while campaigning on a promise to protect Rockland County's migrants.

Senate Passes $70 Billion ICE Funding Bill  (by Pablo Manríquez). Republicans in the upper chamber cleared the money for immigration enforcement. Now they have to do it again in the House where Johnson's majority is essentially a moot point.

"I Wish I Had Made More of a Ruckus" (by Pablo Manríquez). Chicago hospital Chaplain Ally Henney confronted a team of ICE agents attempting to abduct a Latino worker off the street in broad daylight this week on the southeast side.

Markwayne Returns to Capitol Hill (by Pablo Manríquez). The new secretary had his first Capitol Hill moment as the boss of DHS. He left senators with more questions than answers. Today, the House gets its turn.

Trump Builds Financial Trap Around Millions of Migrants (by Pablo Manríquez). The One Big Beautiful Bill Act isn't just a spending package — it's infrastructure for a debt-collection machine targeting people who missed a court date, sought medical protection, or simply showed u

Pregnant, Indicted, and Not Backing Down: McIver Returns to Delaney Hall (EXCLUSIVE)  (by Pablo Manríquez). The Trump administration charged her with a felony for showing up. She showed up again to fight for migrant rights and close an infamous for-profit detention center in New Jersey.
Good Morning From Beantown (by Pablo Manríquez)

"100% Against ICE." She Ran the Ad. We Pulled the Record. (by Pablo Manríquez). Rep. April McClain Delaney was the only Maryland Democrat who voted for the Laken Riley Act. Now it seems she wishes she hadn't.

GEO Group Handed $250,000 in Dark Money to a Group Run by Jim Jordan's Former Chief of Staff  (by Pablo Manríquez). POGO's Nick Schwellenbach broke the story of GEO Group's $250K dark money donation to a Jim Jordan-aligned group in POGO Reports.
Join my subscriber chat (by Pablo Manríquez). A private space for paid subscirbers to converse and connect
ACLU's Maribel Hernández Rivera:  La Constitución define Americano, no el presidente.

Jessica Craven discusses the importance of birthright citizenship outside the Supreme Court, emphasizing that individuals born in the United States belong here. She expresses her support for those who question their place, reinforcing the principles of the 14th amendment. This discussion provides a compelling perspective on constitutional law and us citizenship.
In case anyone here is interested in my art making. Otherwise I'll just post news. Nbd
Christian Maldonado joined ACLU outside of the Supreme Court on Wednesday where the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in the birthright citizenship case Barbara v Trump.
ACLU's Anthony Romero describe the vibe in the Supreme Court when Trump came to sit in on the birthright citizenship oral arguments on Wednesday.
Kathleen Martinez in front of the Supreme Court on Wednesday during the oral arguments in the birthright citrizenship case, Barbara v Trump.
Maxsim Borisov was released this week from ICE detention. Here he tells me about the challenges he faced as a gay man inside the Eloy Detention Center #

CAPITOL HILL — Rep. Dan Goldman (D-NY) on his new bill with Rep. Delia Ramirez and Sen. Catherine Cortes Masto to claw back the exorbitant fees the Trump admin now charges unaccompanied migrant CHILDREN to apply for status in the U.S.
Rep. Brad Johnson reacts to how Speaker Mike Johnson refusing to have Adelita Grijalva sworn in
